programs.title: Bamay
programs.desc: Over three parts, we venture to Kalkadoon Country in Mount Isa, QLD. Known for rugged landscapes and rich Indigenous heritage, this region offers a unique glimpse into the heart of the Aussie outback.

programs.title: Toi Time
programs.desc: Jojo, Maia and Tama build a pirate ship and learn about the Moana while Buzz makes sandcastles at the beach.

programs.title: Waabiny Time
programs.desc: Kylie and Lee share some of their knowledge surrounding Noongar Boodja, Noongar Country, and Kylie demonstrates how to make some binoculars at home.

programs.title: Birds Eye View
programs.desc: There's a new Tui in the hood. The birds decide to investigate before noticing the Humans getting into a territory fight of their own.

programs.title: Aussie Bush Tales
programs.desc: Moort sends Jarra to catch a fat goanna for dinner. While he is trying to find that goanna, Jarra goes into a dark and spooky tunnel.

programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: When the mysterious message of the sacred drum is evoked, the alchemist reveals the existence of an ancient statuette of a yellow dragon hidden in a temple in Peking.
